name: DROWL Trademark
description: Dynamically appends a registered-trademark sign (superscript ®) after admin-defined words on rendered pages, client-side via JavaScript.
project_description: DROWL Trademark automatically appends a registered-trademark sign (a superscript ®) after a configurable list of words wherever they appear on rendered front-end pages. The words are defined on a single settings form as a comma-separated list. The marking is applied at runtime in the browser by a small JavaScript behavior (using core jQuery + core/once) rather than by a text input filter, so it also catches text coming from areas that bypass input filtering, such as the menu system. A jQuery exclusion-filter setting lets you skip elements (email links, spamspan output, opted-out containers). The module attaches its script only on non-admin pages. This documented checkout is a development branch (the info.yml carries no version line); treat it as pre-release.
